body: Founder: 'can we start crunching the data on the heroes that are the strongest?' -> 'ok i want to start tracking it on okemily.com.' New migration 202607290001_redgarden_hero_stats.sql (aggregate wins/losses/matches per hero_id, REDGARDEN-specific). New POST /api/v1/redgarden/hero-result (redgarden.match.write) + public GET /api/v1/redgarden/hero-leaderboard?min-games=N (win rate computed at read time). 6 new tests, full suite green. Companion REDGARDEN change reports to this endpoint at match-end; OKEMILY page to follow.
title: feat: hero-level win-rate tracking (redgarden_hero_stats)
